reviews.text:
I left my pet in their care for three days. Thanks to the kind female representative, I was able to leave my pet without any worries.

Thank you very much. I plan to use your service again.

I recently learned about this place and left my pet here, and seeing how much happier he was when he returned from a regular pet hotel, I've decided to continue using their services.

The owners are wonderful people, and I feel at ease knowing they always take such good care of my pet.

I'm so grateful for this wonderful encounter!
She's a babysitter I can trust, and I always consult with her whenever I need to be away from home for an extended period.

I used this pet hotel!
The deciding factors for me were that my pet would be kept at the owner's home, with someone there 24 hours a day, and that I could take him for walks twice a day.
I think the price was a great deal for these conditions.

In the end, I'm very satisfied!!
After I requested, they kept me updated on the situation via LINE and sent me photos, so I felt at ease from start to finish. ^ ^

From the phone inquiry, I could tell that Nagamoto-san had a kind personality, and when I met him in person, he was very polite and I could tell he really loves animals. 🥺
Chachamaru seemed very happy, as people said he was cute and well-behaved! lol

If you're unsure, I recommend giving them a call! You'll have peace of mind. ⭐︎

I always rely on Nagamoto-san for the care of my two beloved cats.

My boss at my previous company introduced me to Mei-chan's House, and it's been almost three years since then.

I ask them to pet-sit at my home when I travel, about once every one or two months.

I send them photos and videos via LINE about the cats' condition, their feeding and litter box activities, and they also give me various advice, which makes me feel at ease and helps a lot.

My brown tabby cat in particular is extremely shy and rarely shows himself to anyone other than family, but after just a few visits with Nagamoto-san, he became completely attached to me, which was amazing.

I'm truly grateful, as he's a master cat-user.

He also recommended a more affordable veterinary hospital than our previous one, which has allowed us to save a lot on medical expenses.

My cats' comfort is what matters most, so I'm always grateful.

I look forward to working with you in the future.

I'm always grateful for the care you give my cat.

You're a veteran sitter with many years of experience caring for dogs and cats, so I feel completely at ease leaving my cat in your care. I'm also very grateful that you're able to accommodate urgent requests. I plan to continue using your services in the future.
I've been a customer for over 10 years and have great trust in them. I'm sure my cats trust them completely too. When they come back from their trips, they seem shinier and plumper than usual.

We've been using your services for a long time, ever since our previous dog was at our parents' house.

You're always so polite and flexible in your responses, which is a real lifesaver.

We look forward to continuing to use your services!

My three dogs (ages 9, 7, and 5 months) recently stayed at this pet hotel.

They adjusted their daily routines to suit each of my three dogs, who are all different in age and personality, and I felt truly at ease leaving them in their care.

They even carefully explained how to administer medication, and I appreciate their meticulous attention to detail.

This is a very trustworthy pet hotel, and I would definitely like to use their services again.

They've been coming to our house whenever we travel for over 10 years now, ever since our cat was about 5 months old. They always put our pets first, which is a huge help. Lately, they've been sending us daily updates via LINE, so we can rest assured even when we're away from home.

Thank you for your continued support!

I request your services several times a year when I travel or visit my family.

You carefully update me on the cats' well-being via Line, so I can stay informed about their appetite and bowel movements, which gives me peace of mind while I'm away. I can see that you play with them a little with cat toys and treat them with love.

The cats seem to remember you, Mr. Nagamoto. I would be delighted to request your services again soon.

I've been a customer of Mei-chan's House for about 27 years since it opened. They always kindly accept my last-minute requests, so I can go out with peace of mind. They take such good care of my cats, and they are always comfortable. I'm always filled with gratitude. Thank you so much 😊 …

I've been a customer for about two years now.

I used to request weekly in-home pet sitting and pet hotel services four or five times a year.

The reason I started using your services was because I suddenly needed to leave my Golden Retriever at a hotel, and I called you on short notice.

From the very first phone call, you listened attentively to my situation and, despite the short notice, you kindly took care of her for about two weeks. You were truly a lifesaver for me at the time.

My dog ​​loves Mr. and Mrs. Nagamoto and is always overjoyed when they come to our house. Every time I drop her off at the hotel, she skips off without even looking back at me! (laughs)

Mr. Nagamoto mainly handled the in-home sitting. He was very thorough in his care, and even brushing, which my dog ​​hates, seemed to enjoy. I think she really looked forward to seeing Mr. Nagamoto once a week.

Now that we've moved, it's become difficult to request your services, but if I ever need pet hotel services again, I've decided it will be at Mei-chan's House!

I feel completely at ease leaving my child with them, and above all, my child loves Mr. and Mrs. Nagamoto, so it feels like a visit home.

I can't thank you enough! Thank you always!

We've been using their services ever since our 10-year-old cat came to live with us. It was our first time welcoming a cat into our home, and they patiently explained all our concerns. Since then, we've been incredibly grateful for their help over the years. We can't thank them enough for their consistently courteous service and consideration. I even think our two cats remember the name "Nagamoto-san"! 😆

My dog ​​is not good with other dogs and doesn't easily get used to just any place, but they take good care of him while keeping an eye on him, and he always comes back full of energy. There's a sense of security that's different from typical pet hotels, and I would like to continue using this pet sitter's services for a long time.

I have an elderly dog ​​and a rabbit, and it's becoming increasingly difficult to find someone to leave them with. While searching for a pet hotel, I found your service online and contacted you.

Initially, I was considering boarding, but Ms. Nagamoto advised me that pet sitting would be a better option given the situation, and she has been coming regularly ever since.

My dog's kidneys have been failing for about a year, and she's noticed his appetite has decreased. Ms. Nagamoto has been very helpful, trying various methods to get him to eat and offering lots of advice.

She also takes care of things like vacuuming and taking out the trash, so I can leave the house without worrying about my pets, and I'm truly grateful.

It feels like she comes more than once a month, and I look forward to continuing to use her services in the future. 🐶🐰

We've been friends with them for 20 years, since our previous dogs.
I'm so grateful that they readily accommodated my last-minute request for a boarding stay.
My dog ​​loves Mei's home and gets excited to get into her carrier when they come to pick her up.
I can leave with peace of mind.

I have been using their services since my dog ​​was a puppy, and I trust them completely. Due to family circumstances, I ask them to look after my dog ​​for about three weeks once a year, and unlike a pet hotel, I feel at ease knowing that they take care of him in their home. They are a trustworthy pet sitter.

They are very kind, and I feel completely at ease leaving my child with them.

I appreciate that they keep me updated on the situation.

They also offer pick-up and drop-off services, so I will definitely use their services again!

I've been using their overnight pet sitting service for over 10 years now. I can't express how much I appreciate Ms. Nagamoto and the other pet sitters. I have three cats, and they provide meticulous care and are incredibly kind to pets. The low price is also a big plus. I love to travel, and I always feel completely at ease leaving my pets in their care!
